kind: Bounded source-only reuse/follow-through gate; after cached prior-decision reconciliation and before any new access or values
scope: Actual authors1,998 clinical-tumor-sample source, distinct from four indexed diagnosis-only portal responses. Authenticate source versions and public clinical histology/case/assay/donor/condition maps before choosing any disease-protein question.
universe: Primary DOI10.64898/2026.07.08.737171/PPR1276017, all clinical MASTER/CATCH/INFORM specimens/conditions if genuine released maps exist; unknown donor and EMC counts remain unknown.
routes: Reuse exact evaluated public author documentation and source-linked original primary-access receipts first. At most2 new genuine author-documented primary/supplement/deposit metadata links; no guessed URL/API/index, full patient metadata or authentication. No unchanged failed-route retries.
before_values: No protein, phosphosite, kinase or outcome cell values. If actual new eligible data appears, freeze one useful distinct question/control/alternatives/disproof and obtain root review before values. Failed serial RET and first-activation hypotheses stay shelved.
prior_art: RET expression/activation already published2014; software/portal/schema/sample-name recovery alone is not a disease finding. Existing R9 body/source/deposit and frontend/backend decisions retained.
alternative: Software examples, local configuration and CPTAC demonstration matrices may be mistaken for a public version of the1998 clinical cohort; labels/sample counts never authenticate case identity or donor independence.
stop: If cached exact author links and primary/deposit decisions already fully evaluate the allowed branch or show unavailable source, preserve that precise result and close without inventing new retrieval/work. No source-free biological hypothesis or arbitrary protein panel.

storage.originals_and_catalogues: Cache-only; focused evaluated source decisions export

restrictions: No FAP-tissue/glycan/structural-genomics/HLA analysis, paid/private/login/auth bypass, spend/GPU/outreach/publication/PR/root mutations/push. No UI or images used.
